name: ui.blockEditor
description: Block view of transformers: the TransformerEditor's Blocks / Form / JSON switch starts on Form, Blocks draws the transformer as blocks and Form brings the form back; the blocks of a stored TransformerDefinition show slots, parameters, object and list blocks and ML schema chips, collapse one by one or all at once, and zoom; a Runner's composite action sequence shows as read-only stacked command blocks, a query step as one block, build transformers marked where they are evaluated at build.

TransformerEditor: the transformer shows the view switch on Form
TransformerEditor: Blocks shows the transformer as blocks, Form brings the form back

steps.label: value blocks have the theme's value color

miroirTests.miroirTestLabel: TransformerEditor: JSON shows the current transformer as JSON, Form after JSON shows the same values

steps.label: edit the returned value in the form
the JSON holds the edited value
no form field for the value
the form shows the edited value

miroirTests.miroirTestLabel: TransformerEditor: turning the field's structured view off selects JSON in the view switch

steps.label: turn the field's structured view off
no form field for the value
